fee_notes: Royalty structure is non-standard: Continuing Fee = 4.5% of Payroll (Funding Costs) + 18% of Gross Margin per Territory; 7.0% of career/permanent placement fees. These are deducted from Gross Margin weekly as part of 'Franchisee's Share' calculation — not expressed as a simple % of gross sales. Cooperative Advertising max 1% of Gross Billings (established by franchisees, not mandatory franchisor fund). Health Insurance Pool up to 3% of Gross Billings, deducted weekly. Direct Deposit Service Fee $25/month. Software fee $1,000 one-time (pre-opening) plus $100/hr for support beyond 12 hrs/year. Payroll Funding Deposit $500 initial year, then equal to daily average temporary employee payroll for prior year Q1, due annually. Security Deposit 1% of Gross Billings until capped at $15,000. Worker's Comp Risk Fee $75/day per injured worker not given light duty. Late Fee 5%/month. Transfer Fee $5,000. Workers' Compensation Loss Ratio Fee up to 200% of franchisee-paid premium if loss ratio exceeds 65%. Minimum Performance Fee = difference between fees paid and fees owed at minimum performance levels.
